# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-9

This Xteink X4 maintenance release improves reading-time estimates, expands the statistics screen, and makes the sleep-session summary reliable across all sleep modes.

## Added

- Added statistics for the current book to the global Reading Statistics screen, including reading time, reading speed, and average session duration.
- Added average session duration to the individual book statistics screen.

## Changed

- Reading speed is now displayed as pages per minute with two decimal places.
- Remaining-time calculations now use reading progress with 0.01% precision while the interface continues to show whole percentages.

## Fixed

- The completed reading-session duration is retained until sleep begins, even if the reader activity has already closed.
- The “I read” transition summary now remains visible for 1.2 seconds in every sleep-screen mode.

## Notes

- Reading sessions shorter than one minute with no page turns remain intentionally excluded from statistics.
- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 only.
